application.name: @gftdcojp/spirit-in-physics
application.description: Jung's Word Association Test Embedding Model for quantifying the human spirit.

processes.name: Pre-flight Device Check
processes.description: Before the session starts, this process verifies that camera and microphone permissions are granted and that the devices are successfully capturing data.
steps: The application requests camera and microphone permissions via `getUserMedia`.
A short (2-second) test recording is initiated.
The system verifies that a non-empty video Blob is generated.
If successful, the user is allowed to proceed to the main session. If not, a specific error is displayed.

processes.name: Data Collection (2 Sessions)
processes.description: Core process where the user performs the word association test. Webcam and microphone are recorded continuously for each session, with periodic overwrite-saving for data integrity.

processes.name: Live Event Logging
processes.description: Throughout each session, every significant event is immediately written to a session-specific log file, ensuring data integrity and supporting session resumption.

components.name: JungVoiceTest
components.description: Handles the entire data collection flow, including the pre-flight check, continuous recording, and event logging.

components.name: kawasakiStore
components.description: Zustand store that manages the session state and orchestrates data saving operations. It receives blobs from the component and forwards them to the server-side API.

components.name: saveArtifactApi
components.description: Server-side API route that receives data from the client (video blobs, log files) and writes them directly to the `artifacts/sessions` directory, overwriting files with the same name.

dataFlows.flow: Full Experiment Execution with Pre-flight Check

steps.action: User is presented with an intro screen and a 'Check Devices' button.
User clicks the button, triggering a camera/mic permission prompt.
A short test recording is performed to verify data is being generated.
If check is successful, the 'Start Session 1' button becomes active. Otherwise, an error is shown.
User clicks 'Start Session 1' to begin the continuous recording and the experiment loop.
(Background Loop) Every 10 seconds, the recording is saved to a file via the API, overwriting the previous version.
The rest of the two-session flow proceeds as previously defined.
